items.title: Building a Frictionless Insurance Advisor with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
items.summary: Frictionless Insurance Advisor is an AI-powered advisory tool built end to end on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Advisors answer customer questions on the spot, compare products across providers, identify coverage gaps, and start applications that fill from the conversation, with compliance controls enforced in code.
items.creator: Antoine Boucherie

items.title: One call, no waiting: Amazon Connect Health expands agentic AI for patient access
items.summary: Amazon Connect Health is expanding its agentic patient access capabilities to include appointment management, prescription management, portal password reset, and information assistance, so patients can handle routine tasks in a single call at any hour, with no phone system replacement required.
items.creator: Naji Shafi
